neighbours.label: hands-on assembly of small parts into a shape (the 'to make'/'arranged in' step where pieces are put together to form something), as opposed to handling the same materials without assembling them
fire: For the project, tape the straws together to make a tall triangle.
Have the children thread the beads onto string to make a bracelet.
Next, twist the two wires together to form a small loop.
Stack the sugar cubes carefully to build a little tower.
Fold the paper strips and staple them together to make a crown.
Line up six matches on the table to form a hexagon.
Press the clay balls together to make the body of the snowman.
Lay the tiles side by side to form a simple chequered pattern.
quiet: For the project, paint the straws bright red and leave them to dry.
Have the children count the beads and sort them by colour.
Next, measure the two wires and write down their lengths.
Buy a box of sugar cubes from the shop on the corner.
Cut the paper strips and throw away the scraps afterwards.
Keep six matches in a dry tin in case the power fails.
Wrap the clay balls in damp cloth so they do not crack.
Clean the tiles with warm soapy water before you put them away.
